card.text: WASP-33 b was found in 2010 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.

sources.quote: WASP-33b is an extrasolar planet orbiting the star HD 15082.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around WASP-33. Its orbit and size follow Chakrabarty & Sengupta 2019's fit, the archive's default.
